summary: A regulator asks whether paying for reports of unregistered bottles would produce useful leads.
realLife: In 2023 testimony on Maine LD 1909 and LD 1910, DEP opposed the proposed reward in LD 1909, saying it would be cumbersome to administer and would add little to existing reporting. In February 2026 DEP reported receiving 34 complaints about noncompliant beverage containers in the previous six months and resolving 22. It did not identify those complaints as paid referrals.
gates: A bill would pay a reward for identifying an unregistered product.
inGame: The bill catalog supplies the bottle-deposit question. needs: a bill would pay a reward for identifying an unregistered product.
